messages:
maria: FYI — vendor QA flagged a perf regression hitting our CUDA 12.2 stack on A100-v5 during their marketplace certification run. They saw ~30% throughput drop for long-context rescores. Partner asks: can we do a temporary driver/launch pin and a hotfix plan?

sam: ugh. do we have a repro? where in the pipeline is it visible?

maria: repro attached (from partner): logs + minimal runner. They run our inference binary with cudnn/cuda 12.2 + driver 531.xx. They say it only appears when KV cache grows > 2M tokens and with model-quantized path on.

cheng: thanks — quick notes: 1) we saw a similar anomaly on one internal fleet node last month but dismissed as perf noise. 2) likely kernel scheduling change in driver impacting cuBLAS/cuFFT tiling for long seqs.

aj: short-term options: a) pin driver to 530.* for marketplace images, b) add a capability flag on marketplace deployment to opt-out of the new driver, c) ship a runtime fallback to scalar attention path (perf hit but safe).

maria: partner wants minimal user-visible disruption. they prefer (a) pin + canary + hotfix branch. also want joint announcement timeline for the marketplace listing update.

nv-bob: (partner) we can hold the marketplace image until you sign off on pin. we'll publish a compatibility note. our engineering will try a micro-hotfix driver by EOD but no guarantees. :+1:

sam: can we gate the marketplace release with a deploy-bot check? e.g., fail marketplace publish if kernel-regression tests fail.

deploy-bot: running marketplace-gating-suite on canary pool...

deploy-bot: marketplace-gating-suite results: 1 failed test (rescore-throughput-longseq), 12 passed. See logs: https://ci.redwood/example-build/1767

cheng: ok, plan proposal: 1) pin marketplace images to driver 530.41 (docs + image tag), 2) create a canary pool running 531.* for 72h with traffic 5% to gather metrics, 3) partner-run hotfix attempt concurrently, 4) if hotfix arrives within 48h we validate and unpin, else keep pin and schedule remediation rollout.

aj: I'll draft the image tag change and the marketplace PR. maria can you coordinate partner comms and the joint announcement copy (we should avoid implying a regression until we have root cause).

maria: will do. timeline: PR by EOD, canary config tomorrow morning, canary start by 16:00 UTC. nv-bob — please ping here when you have hotfix build.

nv-bob: Roger. will update by 15:30 UTC.

sam: also add a monitoring alert for rescore p95 latency + throughput drop so SRE/CS can triage fast.

cheng: added: alert rule "rescore_longseq_degradation" -> paging to eng-runtime on high severity.

maria: thanks all. I'll post the joint comms draft in a follow-up thread once we have PR link. :wave:
